question: How does the frozen contrarian_half 1x/2x Binance account change when actual historical funding is settled into cash and subsequent position sizes?
single_variable: Add official historical Binance USD-M realized funding to the already priced contrarian_half account. Keep the 1,586 parent IDs, relative 1x/2x exposure map, four native child legs, fees, actual H1 prices, 20% single-contract H1 notional trim, nine slots, entry order, and exits fixed. Only exact same-hour funding ownership is bracketed as include/exclude; a separate +5bp market-fill stress is retained.

account.entry_priority: Frozen contrarian_half V1.7 parent event IDs and original entry_order; preserve the original wallet timestamp, entry_order, CRC32 symbol, symbol, event_id priority.
account.hourly_trim: At each H1 open, set the position target from prior completed H1 NAV and prior close so each contract notional is at most 20% of that NAV; execute the VectorBT market reduction at the same H1 open stage with taker fee.

boundary_policy.timestamp_resolution: Use the exact fundingTime milliseconds from the frozen source tape; no time tolerance.
boundary_policy.include_boundary: Charge a settlement exactly at entry after the open entry; an exact open/close exit boundary uses the cached just-held quantity; a settlement inside an intrabar exit hour is applied before that hour's native exit.
boundary_policy.exclude_boundary: Exclude exact entry/open-exit/close-exit boundaries and settlements inside an intrabar exit hour; keep all strictly interior settlements.
boundary_policy.account_order: Exact H1-open settlements precede open orders. Non-exact H1 settlements are posted after the hourly cap reduction and before the native close/intrabar exit. Funding is deducted from available cash first; any amount beyond available cash is carried as a position-margin liability and is repaid from later credits or released collateral.
boundary_policy.risk_limit: The frozen minute-source audit proves both 2x stop-hour crossings strictly precede the corresponding liquidation boundary. This account adapter does not reconstruct historical exchange liquidation-tier changes.

funding_source.zero_settlement_receipt: Use the donor source_months.csv.gz and verified_empty_windows logic. A symbol without tape rows may be skipped only when its complete query receipt proves the full child hold was inside a zero-settlement interval.

network_policy: Offline replay only; no funding collection, archive download, or cross-venue prices

outputs.zero_funding: Persist the four-child VBT zero-funding reconstruction, parent cash ledger, full hourly NAV, orders and exact parity against the frozen contrarian_half account.

interpretation: Funding rows use the actual VectorBT synthetic collateral share quantity converted to signed Binance base-asset quantity by exposure_multiple / entry_price at each settlement. Cashflow changes later available balance and therefore later VBT order sizes. Do not add aggregate funding to the old terminal NAV as a nominal correction.
